notes.title: Happy World Gorrilla Day!
notes.notes:
Happy World Gorrilla Day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34593165/f0ca3a3ce7d4a8d0b5783f70a9ce7f63b776677f.png[/img]

Did you know: [b]A gorilla is up to 10x stronger than average Joe.[/b] Unfortunately, in vApe Escape world, apes are used by the wealthy hipsters of the universe as vaping dispenser machines. :( 

vApe Escape is a [i][b]satirical science fiction story[/b][/i] with an emphasis on how society neglects caged animals told from a viewpoint of an imprisoned ape on a spaceship.

vApe Escape is completely free and takes about 20 minutes to solve. It has never been easier to save an ape in a video game. What are you waiting for?

P.S. Join our Discord channel to chat about apes, games and everything else: https://discord.gg/GF3PRKm

notes.title: The Lot is Available for Wishlist
notes.notes:
[i]A lot of things have been going on in Gamechuck lately.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34593165/7a26c7ada67e7fc41fe5038b58e5a4ea183ff50f.jpg[/img]

Aside from releasing [b]vApe Escape[/b] and its [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1044510/vApe_Escape__Original_Soundtrack/]soundtrack[/url][/i] during the last week, we've been working hard on our other "interactive comics" games. 

Our next point 'n' click adventure is called [b]The Lot[/b] and it is already available for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041120/The_Lot/]wishlist[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34593165/0563ed34584b6d6a90036a19a68da0af5f63e023.jpg[/img]

Meet [b]Harry Hunter[/b], the protagonist of the Lot and a freelance parking attendant, who dreams of getting promoted to the full-time position. But when a freeloading owner of a blue Mustang drives through his parking lot without paying for the ticket, Harry ventures inside, dead set to find him and make him pay.

The Lot will include [i]multiple paths, endings and side-quests [/i]spanning thousands of lines of dialog tightly packed in a 2 hour narrative, as well as a [i]new game+ option with developer's commentary[/i] when you finish the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34593165/8c48067c9a6f5c8702ddbdc69603c8a47e95c25e.jpg[/img]

Just like our other interactive comics, upon finishing the game you can print out your entire adventure path in the form of an [b]actual 30-50 page comic book[/b].

We'll reveal more about The Lot story and features as the development furthers so head to the store page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041120/The_Lot/]wishlist the game[/url] and stay tuned. ;) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34593165/fd83a6d6a2e490a2a2dcbd0e87bfd2316332fc8d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [INTERACTIVE COMICS] All You Can Eat on 50% Discount ($0.99)
notes.notes:
